send_slack_message: send a slack message to a configured channel using its webhook URL
activate_slack_exception_swallower: activate the SlackExceptionSwallower context manager to catch and log exceptions to a slack channel
use_global_slack_exception_swallower: use the GLOBAL_SLACK_EXCEPTION_SWALLOWER singleton to swallow and report exceptions via slack
configure_incoming_webhooks: configure INCOMING_WEBHOOKS by setting SLACK_SECRETS_DIR to load webhook URLs from files
review_slack_exception_swallower_class: review the SlackExceptionSwallower class and its context manager methods for exception handling
